# Retained agent kit

`dojo-video-agent-kit-0.2.0.tgz` is the unchanged MIT kit built from harness commit
`89bafad93bcd5f02fd529ab64eee1a6a24d8f4f0`, SHA-256
`c666457afb224b604c6ad3ff9194c88e331de25ece127ca64d57d5aa11bdbec9`.
It retains the coordinator and exact contracts for already accepted local v6 work
while new authoring capabilities use a separately versioned kit. Never repack it.

`dojo-video-agent-kit-0.2.1.tgz` is the unchanged tested candidate built from
`028e467acbc88263d2c7d17e500ad2e525c5c0c7`, SHA-256
`be124e6595b7f15a963a6a934157c12062a69f5f39f429bb9fca2ec4323a051f`.
It preserves local v7/commercial v8 contracts and the known paid trial.
